decision_scope: Hold the outlying Fordsburg locality candidate out of factual geography and runtime admission until independent identity support resolves its referent.
rationale: The two Fordsburg identities are about 19.3 km apart, beyond the governed 15 km same-name settlement merge bound.
The outlying locality has moderate identity confidence, no direct cross-identifier, three withheld fuzzy proposals, two ambiguous source matches, and a source-disputed candidate type.

The available evidence does not establish that the outlying records are the supported Fordsburg suburb or an independently supported locality; keep the identity unresolved without merging or retiring it.
The supported suburb has its own OSM and NGA source records and an exact reviewed Stats SA settlement_within edge to Johannesburg; retain that identity and edge unchanged.
reconsider_when: Independent cross-identifier or authoritative locality evidence resolves the outlying records' identity; any merge or retirement requires a separate data-quality decision.
